comment: The control mapping of the WinUI theme port (docs/porting/winui-theme.md, section 6). `ferroui`: every document of the Fluent theme (src/FerroUI.Themes.Fluent/Controls), the default control themes it defines ({Type}), the WinUI 3 styles and resources the WinUI theme builds them from, and the work batch that ports it. `winui`: every target type of a WinUI style of the merged theme, the FerroUI control its implicit style themes (null: no FerroUI control; the waivers say why), and the batch. Read by scripts/winui-theme/status.py, which renders both tables into the design document.

batches.F: Foundation: the crate, the resources, the window and popup hosts, and the button, check box, radio button, text box and scroll viewer families
batches.B5: Navigation, pages, tabs and command bar
batches.B6: Window decorations, notifications, tables and dialogs

native_additions.coverage: The ordinary FerroUI control namespace provides a native RadioButtons group with selection, items and column layout. Its replaceable metadata template uses native RadioButton controls and their existing themes.
native_additions.remaining: The original RadioButtons implicit style, item style and scoped resource declarations remain pending. The former no-control waivers no longer apply. The native group implementation does not certify source template parts, all resource metrics, HighContrast or pixel parity.

native_additions.coverage: The ordinary FerroUI control namespace provides InfoBadge. WinUIControls.xaml merges its dictionary, which supplies the implicit theme, DefaultInfoBadgeStyle, and all five severity families with dot/value/icon themes. Migration changes Style to Theme. The native replaceable template handles value, icon and dot presentation; colors use Default, Light and HighContrast dictionaries. The native NavigationViewItem can host this badge and the Gallery includes the original navigation-badge composition; exact source navigation visuals remain separate.
native_additions.remaining: The scanner counts resource declarations in their original theme scope. Shared dimensions and margins are supplied at dictionary root, so their upstream variant-scoped entries remain pending in this strict inventory. Matching resource keys does not establish complete upstream VisualState, icon-source, source-specific NavigationView badge visuals, platform accessibility or pixel parity. The native implementation is pinned separately from this theme reference.

native_additions.coverage: The ordinary FerroUI control namespace provides a native ProgressRing with a replaceable Arc template and framework-clock animation. Explicit Foreground/Background values take precedence; the control resolves ProgressRingForegroundThemeBrush and ProgressRingBackgroundThemeBrush from the active theme, with accent and native color fallbacks. These lookups support application-provided resources; they do not define the missing source dictionaries.
native_additions.remaining: The original implicit style and seven source resource entries remain pending. The default Arc template computes stroke width and does not consume ProgressRingStrokeThickness. Exact Lottie geometry, determinate endpoint trim keyframes, AnimatedVisualPlayer and custom DeterminateSource/IndeterminateSource remain unported; native shape motion is an adaptation, not pixel parity. HighContrast source brush declarations are not supplied by this addition.

native_additions.coverage: The ordinary FerroUI control namespace provides a native RatingControl with replaceable foreground/background item panels and a caption. Independent glyph/image visuals, fractional clips and native transforms render the rating, placeholder and pointer preview. The control resolves RatingControl state-brush keys, RatingControlFontSizeForRendering and RatingControlItemSpacing, including zero spacing, with native fallbacks.
native_additions.remaining: The original implicit style and 34 source resource entries remain pending. Resource lookup does not supply the scoped source dictionaries, four WinUI item DataTemplates or MUX_RatingControlDefaultFontInfo. RatingControlCaptionTopMargin and text-scale-dependent glyph sizing are not projected. Composition-expression animation timing, installed glyph fonts, HighContrast appearance, custom WinUI templates, platform accessibility and pixel parity require separate implementation or acceptance.

native_additions.coverage: The ordinary FerroUI control namespace provides a native ContentControl with a replaceable metadata template built from SplitView, panels, presenters and buttons. It supplies menu/footer sources, selection and settings, hierarchy, native focus/input and adaptive pane modes. Existing NavigationView resource declarations remain available to the theme; resource lookup and a Rust metadata template do not supply the source implicit style.
native_additions.remaining: The source {NavigationView} style is pending. NavigationViewTemplateSettings, the original VisualState/animation/acrylic/title-bar contracts, top overflow redistribution and the compact PaneAutoSuggestButton contract remain absent or unverified. The corresponding overflow and pane-search styles retain explicit feature waivers. Source template-part compatibility, HighContrast appearance, platform accessibility and pixel parity require separate implementation or acceptance.

native_additions.coverage: The additive native item supplies replaceable content/icon/badge presenters, a row button, expansion affordance, child host, selection indicator and native child popup. It resolves selected source brush keys with native fallbacks. These native parts preserve the item behavior without declaring a source ControlTheme or a NavigationViewItemPresenter implementation.
native_additions.remaining: The source {NavigationViewItem} and MUX_NavigationViewSettingsItemStyleWhenOnTopPane styles are pending. Public NavigationViewItemPresenter and its TemplateSettings remain absent, so the three MUX presenter styles retain explicit waivers; deprecated Reveal-focus variants remain waived separately. Original WinUI visual states, resource-driven metrics and motion, HighContrast, platform accessibility and pixel parity remain separate.

native_additions.coverage: The additive native nonfocusable header has a replaceable ContentPresenter template and follows the parent hierarchy and closed-compact context. The existing NavigationViewItemHeaderTextStyle key remains part of the theme inventory; the native metadata template is a separate implementation.
native_additions.remaining: The source {NavigationViewItemHeader} implicit style is pending. Declaring an available header control or reusing the text-style resource does not establish the original header template, all source metrics, visual states, HighContrast or pixel parity.

native_additions.coverage: The additive native nonfocusable separator uses a replaceable Border template, changes orientation for top navigation, and resolves the NavigationViewItemSeparatorForeground or TopNavigationViewItemSeparatorForeground brush. Existing source resource definitions and the native brush consumer are tracked separately.
native_additions.remaining: The source {NavigationViewItemSeparator} implicit style is pending. The native line and metadata template do not supply the original style declarations, resource-driven metrics, state transitions, HighContrast acceptance or pixel parity.

document_batches.comment: The batch of the styles of a source document (a prefix of its path, or path#key for one style), before the batch of their target type: the keyed styles of the documents of a control belong to the batch of that control.

ferroui.winui: No WinUI style: the system focus visual of WinUI (FocusVisualPrimaryBrush/Thickness, FocusVisualSecondaryBrush/Thickness; the SystemControlFocusVisual* resources of Common_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI control: the spin buttons of NumberBox (NumberBoxSpinButtonStyle, NumberBox.xaml) and the TextBox resources.
The month and year items of CalendarView (CalendarViewBaseItem resources of CalendarView_themeresources.xaml).
The header, navigation buttons and views of the CalendarView template (DefaultCalendarViewStyle).
No WinUI control: built from FlipView (DefaultFlipViewStyle) and the page background (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush).

CommandBar: DefaultCommandBarStyle, DefaultCommandBarOverflowPresenterStyle (CommandBar_themeresources.xaml); AppBarButton: DefaultAppBarButtonStyle, AppBarButtonOverflowStyle; AppBarToggleButton: DefaultAppBarToggleButtonStyle, AppBarToggleButtonOverflowStyle; AppBarSeparator: DefaultAppBarSeparatorStyle.
No WinUI style (Page has none): the page background and text of the window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush).

No WinUI style (input validation was removed from WinUI 3): the critical fill of the palette (SystemFillColorCriticalBrush) for the message and the border of the field, and the error icon of InfoBar (InfoBar.xaml, InfoBar_themeresources.xaml) for the tool tip variant.
No WinUI control: the pane of NavigationView (NavigationView_themeresources.xaml) and SplitView (DefaultSplitViewStyle).
No WinUI style: the background and text of the window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).

No WinUI control in the merged theme: built from the control fills of the palette (ControlStrongFillColorDefaultBrush, ControlStrongFillColorDisabledBrush) and the accent fill for the preview (AccentFillColorDefaultBrush).
No WinUI control: an expanded Expander without its chevron (DefaultExpanderStyle, Expander.xaml; the header of ExpanderHeaderDownStyle, Expander_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI style: the header presenter of the WinUI controls with a Header (TextBox: HeaderContentPresenter, TextBoxTopHeaderMargin, TextControlHeaderForeground).
No WinUI style in the merged theme (ItemsControl has a built-in template): an ItemsPresenter of the ItemsPanel.
No WinUI control: the implicit style of ContentControl ({ContentControl}, generic.xaml), which Controls/Label.xaml ports.
No WinUI control: built from the ListViewItem (ListViewItem_themeresources.xaml), TextBox, Button and ContentDialog (DefaultContentDialogStyle) styles.

MenuFlyoutItem: DefaultMenuFlyoutItemStyle; MenuFlyoutSubItem: DefaultMenuFlyoutSubItemStyle; ToggleMenuFlyoutItem: DefaultToggleMenuFlyoutItemStyle (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml); RadioMenuFlyoutItem: DefaultRadioMenuFlyoutItemStyle (RadioMenuFlyoutItem_themeresources.xaml).
The ScrollViewer of the MenuFlyoutPresenter template (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI control: NavigationBackButtonNormalStyle, NavigationBackButtonSmallStyle (NavigationBackButton.xaml) and the page background.
No WinUI style: the text of the window (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
No WinUI style (IconElement has no template): the Path that WinUI's PathIcon builds in code (CPathIcon::ApplyTemplate, icon.cpp), unscaled and filled with the Foreground.

PipsPager: {PipsPager} (PipsPager.xaml), PipsPagerNavigationButtonBaseStyle, PipsPagerPreviousPageButtonStyle, PipsPagerNextPageButtonStyle, PipsPagerButtonBaseStyle, PipsPagerSelectedPipButtonStyle, PipsPagerNormalPipButtonStyle (PipsPager_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI style: the text of the window (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
No WinUI control (TextBlock.IsTextSelectionEnabled): the selection colours of the text selection manager of WinUI (SystemControlHighlightAccentBrush, SystemColorHighlightTextColor).
MenuFlyoutSeparator: {MenuFlyoutSeparator} (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml); AppBarSeparator for a separator in a command bar.

No WinUI control: NavigationView with its pane at the top (TopNavArea of NavigationView.xaml, MUX_NavigationViewItemPresenterStyleWhenOnTopPane of NavigationView_themeresources.xaml) and the page background.

No control of the merged theme: WinUI's TableView of the tabular library (controls/dev/TableView, TableView_themeresources.xaml, not part of XamlControlsResources) is the closest source; the ListViewItem resources otherwise.
As TableView: the cells of controls/dev/TableView.
As TableView: the column headers of controls/dev/TableView and SortIndicator.
As TableView: the rows of controls/dev/TableView; the ListViewItem resources.

TextBox: DefaultTextBoxStyle and its DeleteButtonStyle (TextBox_themeresources.xaml); PasswordBox: DefaultPasswordBoxStyle (PasswordBox_themeresources.xaml), a keyed theme with the reveal button; the context flyout of TextCommandBarFlyout as a menu flyout (B3).
No WinUI style (the selection grippers are drawn in code, Gripper.cpp): the gripper circles in SystemColorWindowColor outlined in TextControlSelectionHighlightColor.
No WinUI style: the text foreground (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush).
No WinUI style: the template of ContentControl ({ContentControl}, generic.xaml), twice, for the page transition of the control.

No WinUI style (Window is not a control in WinUI 3): the Mica fallback background and text of a window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
TitleBar: DefaultTitleBarStyle (TitleBar.xaml, TitleBar_themeresources.xaml); WindowCaptionButton (generic.xaml) for the caption buttons.
No WinUI control: a host of InfoBar cards (InfoBar_themeresources.xaml).

ButtonBase.note: keyed styles of the date and time picker flyouts and TextBlockButtonStyle

CommandBarOverflowPresenter.note: the overflow presenter is part of the CommandBar template in FerroUI

ContentControl.note: ContentControl has a built-in template in FerroUI; Label is built from it and claims the implicit style

ContentPresenter.note: FerroUI's ContentPresenter is not templated; the implicit style is waived

FlipViewItem.note: the items of a Carousel are its content presenters

InfoBadge.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.InfoBadge; native control API and InfoBadge.xaml ControlThemes. Resource key coverage is separate from exact visual parity.

ListViewItem.note: the keyed ListViewItem styles; the implicit one has no FerroUI control (no ListView)

LoopingSelector.note: the looping lists of the date and time picker presenters; FerroUI's DateTimePickerPanel is a panel, not templated, so the selectors are part of the DatePickerPresenter and TimePickerPresenter themes

LoopingSelectorItem.note: the items of the date and time picker presenters

MenuBarItem.note: the top-level items of a Menu

NavigationViewItem.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.NavigationViewItem; native content/icon/badge/hierarchy parts. The original implicit and top settings-item styles remain pending.

NavigationViewItemPresenter.note: No public native NavigationViewItemPresenter or its TemplateSettings. The native NavigationViewItem row parts do not implement that source class; its presenter styles remain waived.

NavigationView.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.NavigationView; replaceable native metadata template and resource lookup. The original implicit style remains pending; DrawerPage keeps its separate existing page contract.

NavigationViewItemHeader.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.NavigationViewItemHeader; native nonfocusable heading. The original implicit style remains pending.

NavigationViewItemSeparator.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.NavigationViewItemSeparator; native nonfocusable line and orientation. The original implicit style remains pending.

PasswordBox.note: FerroUI's TextBox with a PasswordChar; ported as the keyed DefaultPasswordBoxStyle

ProgressRing.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.ProgressRing; native Arc template and brush lookup. Source style/resource declarations and exact Lottie/stroke visuals remain pending.

RadioButtons.note: Native FerroUI.Controls.RadioButtons; replaceable metadata template and native RadioButton items. Original group/item styles and scoped resource declarations remain pending.

RatingControl.note: Additive FerroUI.Controls.RatingControl; native glyph/image template, clipping and resource lookup. Original styles, item DataTemplates and exact source visuals remain pending.

Rectangle.note: keyed styles of template parts (ComboBoxItemPill, SelectorBarItemPill)

SplitMenuFlyoutItem.note: no FerroUI counterpart: MenuItem has no split mode (waived)

TextBlock.note: keyed styles (BodyTextBlockStyle, ...) become keyed control themes of TextBlock

Thumb.note: the default theme of FerroUI's Thumb (the thumbs of ScrollBar and Slider have keyed themes)

ToggleSplitButton.note: FerroUI's ToggleSplitButton overrides its style key to SplitButton
